result.prior_version_note: Before August 1, 2025, the introductory paragraph of clause (1)(b) read: "At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay any amount in excess of the following." It did not mention an "agent of the lessor" or payments made to an agent. St. 2025, c. 9, §§ 54-55 added that language. The documents mark only this introductory paragraph as amended. They do not say when the fee-in-lieu language in clause (iii) was added, so the rule's statement that it arrived with the August 1, 2025 amendment is not supported. A secondary source (DX13) says only that the law "has been in effect since the 1970s"; no exact original effective date is given.
